scope: Changed bootstrap account contract, Admin role/password/session boundaries, UI authentication/password/SSE boundary, service-worker cache boundary and exact WebSocket/SBOM transform. Code and fixtures; not independent certification or whole-product penetration test.

independence.otherImplementation: Reviewed by a separate agent from the authors, within the same AI-assisted development session. No external independence claim.
independence.serviceWorker: Reviewer authored the narrowly delegated sw.ts change and focused test; its 18 source and 18 generated checks are self-tests, not independent review.

contract.authority: Exactly one canonical active group; root enrollment owns identities/memberships. Raw browser identity mutation denied for all roles; narrow own-password/reset handlers retain bounded authority.
contract.accountAcl: 0x600 owned by system.user.admin/system.group.administrator; generic non-Service controller permissions all false.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Admin startup could rewrite or mirror root-owned role membership/ACLs.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Integrated startup verifies canonical groups and refreshes cache only; raw identity CRUD/password commands blocked even for Service.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Upstream cached raw object reads and subscriptions could disclose native secrets or password hashes to non-Service roles.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Actual dispatch table denies non-Service raw reads and subscription commands before upstream handlers; 2.6.0 fixture checks no implicit global-subscription publication and synchronous revocation.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Ambiguous canonical membership or mutable role aliases could disagree across components.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Admin and UI require exactly one canonical active group; no username/config alias grants authority; root validates exact enrolled inventory.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Password setup metadata/group-enabled changes were not uniformly bound to session authorization.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Current account and role revisions include relevant setup/enabled flags; per-request and event revocation checked.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: SSE authorization could become stale; anonymous logout could affect other sessions; timed-out authorization could accumulate.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Per-frame authorization, two-second deny deadline, pending work held until actual settlement at maxClients, scoped logout and session-specific stream closure; reviewed current code and component fixtures.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Service worker cached protected HTML/API content across authentication boundaries.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: No protected pre-cache or fallback; public same-origin/query-free static asset allowlist only; old EOS cache purge. Self-tested 18 source plus 18 generated checks.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Concurrent security changes during password proof/KDF could use stale authorization; expensive work needed bounds.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Account revision and current role/session checked before and after expensive work; own writes narrowly scoped; bounded KDF concurrency. No atomic cross-adapter CAS claimed.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Admin same-origin helper did not explicitly constrain scheme to HTTPS.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: HTTP caller now passes https: and component regression covers mismatch.

resolvedReviewFindings.issue: Actual ws-server 4.5.1 had a 500 MiB inbound payload default.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Root implemented exact original/output hash-bound 1 MiB transform with package/version and actual Admin dependency resolution checks; reviewed source. Actual assembled oversized-frame test remains separate root integration evidence.

componentEvidenceInspected.note: Component evidence is attributable to its authors; counts overlap and must not be summed as unique requirements. Final assembled integration/SBOM/packaging gates belong to root release evidence.

limitations.detail: No cross-process atomic compare-and-swap for simultaneous administrative password resets; coordinate such resets. Rechecks reduce stale-proof windows; they do not provide transaction isolation.
Shared runtime/database identity does not isolate a compromised adapter. Root ownership and transport encryption are not a per-adapter sandbox.
Normal user/group events synchronously revoke before publication. Missed events additionally rely on a five-second socket watchdog; not an instantaneous distributed-revocation guarantee.
Raspberry Pi 5/Debian target performance, hardware/device behavior, independent penetration test, external conformity determination and production release are outside this review.
Current assembled controller/HTTPS/WebSocket integration, final SBOM and signed immutable artifact must be checked against final source separately; this report is not their approval.
